notes:
## Changes
- Downloads has one total, in the status bar (files and size), instead of two that could disagree. Reading progress is a line of text in the status bar, and Refresh sits in the toolbar.
- The main status bar only shows a folder's figures while a folder is open, with the folder's name. Running time reads "94 days" at a glance; hover for the exact figure. Captions are no longer in capitals.
- Choose a cover: one "Use your own picture..." button. Click it to pick a file, or drop a picture on it.

## Fixes
- Duplicate scenes said "1 plays"; picture sizes now read "1920 × 1080".
- Backup dates use one style ("20 Nov 2026, 15:06").
- Downloads sizes have one decimal place, as everywhere else.
- "HDD label" is now "Drive name".
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
